setup: Gradians and degrees measure the same turn, with 100 gradians equal to 90 degrees, and this instance scales that pair by [[k]].

steps.say: One right angle is 90 degrees or 100 gradians, so one degree is 10/9 of a gradian and one gradian is 9/10 of a degree.
The given angle is a multiple of 9 degrees or of 10 gradians, so the conversion is exact and stays a whole number.
Scaling by [[k]] keeps the proportion, so the converted measure follows from multiplying or dividing by that factor.
